# Issam Albalushi, The Languages Ninja

> Private, customizable tours of Oman with Issam Albalushi, The Languages Ninja, guiding since 2016 in 12 languages. Muscat, Nizwa, Wahiba Sands and Wadi Shab, from USD 200. Book on WhatsApp.

Issam Albalushi ("The Languages Ninja", trading as Oman with Issam) is a private tour guide in Oman, guiding since 2016 and with about 15,000 travelers hosted. Tours are guided in Arabic, English, German, Russian, Spanish, Italian, French, Portuguese, Catalan, Chinese, Hindi, Balochi, and one tour can mix two languages. Tours are private, for 1 to 45 travelers, with pickup wherever guests stay. Prices start at USD 200. Bookings are made on WhatsApp (https://wa.me/96872738685), by email (Languagesninja@gmail.com) or with the tour request form. Interpreting, translation and help with investing, real estate and legal matters in Oman are also available. Rated 5.0 out of 5 on Tripadvisor from 105 reviews (https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g1940497-d28122142-Reviews-LocalGuide-Muscat_Muscat_Governorate.html). Website: https://omanwithissam.com/en/.

## Tours

- [Muscat Authentic City Tour](https://omanwithissam.com/en/tours/muscat-city/): A private Muscat city tour in your language with Issam, The Languages Ninja: the Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque and hidden gems of the capital. Half day or full day, pickup wherever you stay.
- [Nizwa Historical Tour](https://omanwithissam.com/en/tours/nizwa-mountains/): A private day trip from Muscat to Nizwa with Issam, The Languages Ninja: immerse yourself in ancient Oman, guided in your language. About 8 hours, all year round.
- [Wahiba Sands Tour](https://omanwithissam.com/en/tours/wahiba-desert/): A private day trip from Muscat to the Wahiba Sands (Sharqiya Sands) by Toyota 4x4 with Issam, The Languages Ninja: dunes, camel rides, quads and dune bashing, guided in your language.
- [Wadi Shab Adventure](https://omanwithissam.com/en/tours/wadi-shab-coast/): A private Wadi Shab day trip from Muscat with Issam, The Languages Ninja: canyon walls, natural erosion and swimming pools, with the Bimmah Sinkhole as an extra. About 6 hours.
- [Private Muscat by Night Tour](https://omanwithissam.com/en/tours/muscat-night/): Private Muscat by night tour with Issam (The Languages Ninja) in your language: the Royal Opera House lit up, the Mutrah Corniche and the souq in the evening. Pickup wherever you stay.
- [Private Nizwa by Night Tour](https://omanwithissam.com/en/tours/nizwa-night/): Private Nizwa by night tour from Muscat with Issam (The Languages Ninja) in your language: Nizwa Fort lit up and the souq around it in the evening. Pickup wherever you stay.
- [Private Al Hamra Old Village Tour](https://omanwithissam.com/en/tours/al-hamra/): Private day trip from Muscat to the old mud-brick village of Al Hamra with Issam (The Languages Ninja) in your language, with Misfat Al Abriyeen on request. Pickup wherever you stay.
- [Private Multi-Day Oman Round Trip](https://omanwithissam.com/en/tours/multi-day/): Private round trip of several days across Oman with Issam (The Languages Ninja) in your language: Nizwa, Al Hamra, the Wahiba Sands, Wadi Shab and Sur, planned with you, with help booking hotels.

- [The best time to visit Oman, month by month](https://omanwithissam.com/en/guide/best-time-to-visit-oman/): When to visit Oman: October to April is the most pleasant, summer is very hot in Muscat and the desert, and Salalah turns green in the monsoon. Month by month, from a local guide.
- [Oman itinerary: 3, 5 and 7 days](https://omanwithissam.com/en/guide/oman-itinerary/): How to spend 3, 5 or 7 days in Oman from Muscat: the Grand Mosque and Mutrah, Nizwa, the Wahiba Sands, Wadi Shab and Al Hamra, with driving distances and tips from a local guide.
- [Things to do in Muscat](https://omanwithissam.com/en/guide/things-to-do-in-muscat/): The best things to do in Muscat, Oman: the Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, Mutrah Corniche and Souq, Old Muscat, the Royal Opera House and Muscat by night, with dress code tips.

## FAQ

- What are the best tours in Oman? Most first visits combine Muscat (the Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque and Mutrah), Nizwa and its fort, a day in the Wahiba Sands and the pools of Wadi Shab. Issam runs all four as private day tours, plus evenings in Muscat and Nizwa, Al Hamra and multi-day round trips.
- How much does a private tour in Oman cost? Tours with Issam start at USD 200. The final price depends on the tour, whether you need a car or a bus, and the language.
- How many days do I need in Oman? Muscat alone is a full day. With Nizwa, the desert and Wadi Shab, four or five days let you see the classic places without rushing. Issam can plan the days with you and help book hotels.
- When is the best time for tours in Oman? September to May is the most comfortable time for Muscat, the desert and the wadis. Nizwa can be visited all year.
- How much does a private tour cost? Tours start at USD 200. The final price depends on the tour, on whether you need a car or a bus, and on the language. Send your dates and group size on WhatsApp for a quote.
- Where do you pick us up? Wherever you are staying. Issam picks up anywhere.
- How long are the tours? Muscat is a half day (8:00 to 12:00) or a full day (8:00 to 15:00). Wadi Shab takes about 6 hours, Nizwa and the Wahiba Sands about 8. Tours can be combined into a trip of several days.
- Which languages do you guide in? Twelve: Arabic, English, German, Russian, Spanish, Italian, French, Portuguese, Catalan, Chinese, Hindi and Balochi. One tour can mix two languages, so mixed groups are welcome.
- How big can the group be? Every tour is private, for 1 to 45 travelers. Small groups travel by car and larger groups by bus.
- How do we book and pay? Message on WhatsApp or send the request form. A deposit confirms your date. You can pay by card, cash, online, or by bank transfer as long as the money arrives before the tour.
- What is the cancellation policy? There is no refund after confirmation, unless the tour cannot be delivered because of a failure on our side. If bad weather or a flooded wadi stops a tour, you get an alternative, or a refund if there is none.
- How far ahead should we book? Booking is flexible. Message as early as you can, and last-minute requests are welcome too.
- Can you help us book hotels? Yes.
- Does it rain in Oman? Yes, it does. If the weather closes a route, Issam plans an alternative.
- Can we pay by card in Oman? In most places, yes. Taxis are the exception, so carry some cash.
